name: Tiền ăn giữa ca, ăn trưa (meal allowance paid in money)
authority: Decree 253/2026/NĐ-CP art.8(2)(g) with art.69(1)(b): a meal allowance the employer pays is taxable only above 1,200,000 a month from 1 July 2026. Counts toward PIT.MEAL, where the PIT base takes only the part above the cap. Outside the insurance salary, whatever its amount or regularity, so the class counts toward no insurance scheme: Law 41/2024/QH15 art.31(1)(b) with Decree 158/2025/NĐ-CP art.7(1)(c) brings in only the other supplements (các khoản bổ sung khác) of a stated amount agreed with the wage and paid regularly and stably each pay period, and Circular 10/2020/TT-BLĐTBXH art.3(5)(c) (in force from 1 January 2021) sets the mid-shift meal (tiền ăn giữa ca) apart from those supplements as a benefit written as a separate item of the labour contract. The earlier SI-specific list naming it (Circular 59/2015/TT-BLĐTBXH art.30(3) as amended by Circular 06/2021/TT-BLĐTBXH) was repealed from 1 July 2025 by Circular 12/2025/TT-BNV art.20(2); the Circular 10/2020 text: https://storage-vnportal.vnpt.vn/gov-lan/SharePointFolders/Lists/VanBanQPPL/Attachments/207/thong-tu-10-2020-noi-dung-hdld-cong-viec-anh-huong-xau-toi-sinh-san.pdf Prorated on the base salary’s basis (Decree 145/2020 art.54(1)(a)): the working days of the employment over the planned working days, a part of a semi-monthly half at the monthly day wage.

name: Tiền thuê nhà, điện, nước trả thay (rent paid on the employee’s behalf)
authority: Decree 253/2026/NĐ-CP art.8(2)(h): rent, electricity, water and related services the employer pays on the worker’s behalf are taxable at the amount paid but not above 15% of the worker’s total taxable income at the unit, the rent excluded. The employer pays the landlord, so the line is an employer cost, not pay. Counts toward PIT.HOUSING, where the PIT base takes the lower of the amount and that 15%. Rent paid to the landlord is not a wage paid to the worker, so it is outside the insurance salary of Law 41/2024/QH15 art.31(1)(b) and Decree 158/2025/NĐ-CP art.7(1); Circular 06/2021/TT-BLĐTBXH, cited here before, was repealed from 1 July 2025 by Circular 12/2025/TT-BNV art.20(2). Prorated on the base salary’s basis (Decree 145/2020 art.54(1)(a)): the working days of the employment over the planned working days, a part of a semi-monthly half at the monthly day wage.
